svg.title: Golden Signals, RED & USE
svg.desc: Golden Signals, RED & USE. What to measure and alert on: latency, traffic, errors and saturation, RED for request-driven services and USE for resources. Step 1, Alerts on causes: 140 rules on causes page every night while users are fine; Saturday's 2.4 s search paged nobody. Step 2, The four golden signals: Measure what users feel: p99 850 ms, 1,200 req/s, 0.4% errors, DB pool 46 of 50 in use (92%). Step 3, RED and USE in practice: Page on the symptom (p99 > 800 ms for 10 min); RED shows search is slow, USE finds the pool full. Step 4, Common pitfalls: Averages hide the tail, a 200 can be an error, saturation needs a limit, pages must be actionable.
